queries: September 2023 White House AI commitments not legally binding enforcement Reuters

sources_considered.why: Read the complete primary instrument, including its voluntary status and all eight commitments.
Official evidence that existing enforcement powers remained relevant despite voluntary AI initiatives.
Search identified reporting about nonbinding status, but read_page returned HTTP 403; it is not cited.

receipt.public_excerpt:
Companies intend these voluntary
commitments to remain in effect until regulations covering substantially the same issues come
into force.

evidence_items.explanation: The instrument expressly distinguishes voluntary commitments from future regulations. Reading the complete document reveals no new statutory authority, compulsory enforcement process or penalties for failing to implement its eight safeguards.

evidence_items.locator: Page 12, discussion of existing enforcement tools

receipt.public_excerpt:
Indeed, just last month we secured a TRO
against a firm that claimed to use AI to make consumers rich.

evidence_items.explanation: Existing law could produce actual restraints on AI-related business conduct. This limits the phrase 'do as they please', but does not show that the White House commitments themselves created enforcement powers.
